To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

i) the stock prices of listed football companies are positively impacted by sports performance, economic performance, asset and revenue diversifications; ii) the stock price is positively impacted by the club's performance in the domestic league, the European league, and the international league, and negatively impacted by the number of goals scored and the number of goals conceded.
the stock price of European football companies is positively affected by the sports performance, the economic performance, the asset and revenue diversifications, and the market capitalization.
the stock prices of European football clubs are positively affected by the sporting performances, the economic performances, and the diversification of revenues.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the determinants of stock prices of European football clubs and it is expected to be of interest to both academics and practitioners.
the determinants of stock prices of football companies.
the impact of sports and financial performances on stock prices of listed football clubs in Europe.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the results of this study are in line with the existing literature.
a football club’s stock market performance is positively influenced by the club’s performance on the pitch, its financial performance, and its diversification.
the football club’s stock prices are determined by a set of factors that can be classified as sporting performance, economic performance and management.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the football clubs should focus on the sporting and financial performance, and on diversification of their assets and revenues, to increase the value of their shares.
the football club’s performance is a key determinant of the share price.
football club managers should be encouraged to improve their competitive results and their economic-financial performance, in order to attract the investors’ attention.
The main takeaway from our work is that
football clubs should improve their financial performance to increase their stock price and to be more attractive to potential investors.
investors should consider the sporting and the financial performance of the football club when investing in the shares of a club.
investors should not only focus on the financial and economic performance, but also on the sporting performance.
